title: The Myth of Weightlessness in Space!

scenes.text: Astronauts feel weightless, but is that true?
Many believe astronauts float because there’s no gravity in space.
scenes.label: NO GRAVITY IN SPACE

scenes.text: In fact, gravity still exists in space; it's the condition of free fall that creates weightlessness.
scenes.label: GRAVITY STILL EXISTS

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: The truth about weightlessness in space is more fascinating than the myth! Follow for daily science!
